about.title: A father-son team, digging since 2004
text: Curry Excavation & Site Work has been family owned since 2004, started by a father-son team, and Justin Curry is the owner.

All of our employees have the experience and training to execute your project safely and proficiently. We keep communication open with everyone involved, from project managers and superintendents to our subs and suppliers.
Our specialized machines let us expedite jobs on accelerated schedules, and our goal is an exceptional experience from the beginning of your project through completion.
